Float (models 11x/21x): common(1) ID@40003 L=65 · inverter(111/113) ID@40070 L=60 · nameplate(120) ID@40132 L=26 · settings(121) ID@40160 L=30 · status(122) ID@40192 L=44 · controls(123) ID@40238 L=24 · mppt(160) ID@40264, L=48 with 2 MPPT (ROW, no storage) or L=88 with 4 MPPT (all US units, and any unit with storage — MPPT 3 = 'StCha 3', MPPT 4 = 'StDisCha 4') · storage(124) ID@40354 L=24 · US only: DERMeasureAC(701)@40380, DERCapacity(702)@40535, DEREnterService(703)@40587, DERCtlAC(704)@40606, DERVoltVar(705)@40673, DERVoltWatt(706)@40760, DERTripLV(707)@40819, DERTripHV(708)@41024, DERTripLF(709)@41229, DERTripHF(710)@41494, DERFreqDroop(711)@41759, DERWattVar(712)@41813, DERStorageCapacity(713)@41891. Int+SF (models 10x/20x): every model above sits exactly 10 registers lower — common@40003, inverter(101/103)@40070, 120@40122, 121@40150, 122@40182, 123@40228, 160@40254, 124@40344, 701@40370 … 713@41881. sharedMapEvidence: One vendor register-map file covers the whole group and names the members inside itself. `Gen24_Primo_Symo_Inverter_Register_Map_Float_US.xlsx` (and its ROW / Int&SF / storage siblings) is titled "Fronius Gen24 Primo/Symo Inverter Register Map", and its common-block register Md at 40021 carries the model list as the range-of-values column: "e.g. Primo GEN24 6.0, Primo GEN24 10.0, Primo GEN24 10.0
gotchas: THE MODELS DO NOT SIT AT FIXED ADDRESSES AND FRONIUS SAYS SO IN CAPITALS. From the manual: "Register addresses do not remain constant. The actual register addresses depend on the composition of the dynamic SunSpec register list. Correct procedure: Search for the model by making a request (determine start address), then

THE MOVING PART IS MODEL 160. It is L=48 with 2 MPPT modules on a ROW unit with no storage, and L=88 with 4 modules on every US unit and on every unit with a battery. That 40-register difference is what shifts model 124 from 40314 (Datamanager map) to 40354 (GEN24 with storage). Everything after 160 moves with it.

THE MANUAL'S "START ADDRESS" IS ONE LESS THAN THE MODEL'S FIRST REGISTER. Manual: Nameplate 120 float start address 40131. The register map: model 120's ID register is at 40132. The manual's own worked example resolves it — "the register WRtg has an offset of 4, the start address is 40131, therefore the correct registe

AND THEN THERE IS A SECOND OFF-BY-ONE ON THE WIRE. Manual: "To read register 40001, use address 40000 (0x9C40). The register address that is output therefore always has 1 number less than the actual register number." So a driver applies the 1-based model offset AND subtracts one for the PDU. Two independent off-by-ones

THE MANUAL'S END BLOCK FIGURES ARE ONLY TRUE FOR ONE CONFIGURATION. It states inverter End Block at 40313 (float) / 40303 (int+SF). That arithmetic works out only for a 2-MPPT ROW unit with no storage (40264 + 2 + 48 = 40314 = 40313 + 1). On a US or storage unit the End Block is hundreds of registers further along. Not
unmappedReports: inverter(11x) St / StVnd @40118/40119 — operating state (1 OFF, 2 SLEEPING, 3 STARTING, 4 MPPT, 5 THROTTLED, 6 SHUTTING_DOWN, 7 FAULT, 8 STANDBY). No MetricKind for an inverter run state; ValueKind::RunState exists but no metric carries it for an inverter, and ChargeStage is the wrong home., inverter(11x) Evt1/Evt2 @40120/40122 and EvtVnd1/EvtVnd2 @40124/40126 — event bitfields. EvtVnd1 is a Customer-view severity superposition (bit 0 Error, bit 1 Warning, bit 2 Info), EvtVnd2 the Technician view. No MetricKind for fault or alarm state at all. EvtVnd3/EvtVnd4 are marked not supported., inverter(11x) VAr @40098 — AC reactive power. No MetricKind, and no Unit for var/VAR., status(122) Ris — isolation resistance in ohms, with its own auto-scaled Ris_SF. No MetricKind and no Unit::Ohm. This is the one metric that would actually catch a wet or failing array., status(122) PVConn / StorConn / ECPConn — connection bitfields (bit 0 Connected, bit 1 Available, bit 2 Operating). No MetricKind; switch-state is boolean and cannot carry three independent bits., status(122) StActCtl — bitmask of which controls are currently active (bit 0 FixedW, bit 1 FixedVAR, bit 2 FixedPF). No MetricKind., status(122) ActWh — acc64 AC lifetime real energy. Duplicates ac-energy-total at a different width; the 64-bit one is the non-saturating read and the contract cannot express the choice., storage(124) ChaSt — charge status enum (1 OFF, 2 EMPTY, 3 DISCHARGING, 4 CHARGING, 5 FULL, 6 HOLDING, 7 TESTING). ChargeStage cannot express DISCHARGING, HOLDING or TESTING. Same gap the Victron GX entry records for register 844., storage(124) WChaMax, WChaGra, WDisChaGra, MinRsvPct, InWRte, OutWRte, ChaGriSet — the whole storage control surface. No CommandKind for a charge/discharge power window expressed as a signed percentage of a reference power, for a minimum-SoC reserve, or for a charge-from-grid flag. set-charge-current-limit is a current limit; these are percentages of watts., controls(123) WMaxLimPct + WMaxLim_Ena — AC output power limit as % of WMax, scale factor -2. No CommandKind for an export or output power cap., controls(123) OutPFSet, VArMaxPct, VArPct_Ena — constant power factor and constant reactive power setpoints. No CommandKind. ac-power-factor exists as a metric but there is no command counterpart., controls(123) Conn_WinTms / Conn_RvrtTms / *_RvrtTms / *_RmpTms — every control carries a start window, a revert timeout and a ramp time. The contract's commands are fire-and-forget with no timing envelope., nameplate(120) WRtg, VARtg, VArRtgQ1-Q4, ARtg, PFRtgQ1-Q4 — nameplate ratings. Arguably correct to have no MetricKind; recorded because a setup screen wants them., settings(121) WMax, VRef, VRefOfs, VMin, VMax — configuration, and VRef is read-only on this map despite being writable in SunSpec., mppt(160) module/x/DCWH — per-string lifetime energy. pv-energy-total is single-valued, so two strings collapse into one number., mppt(160) module/x/DCSt, module/x/DCEvt, module/x/Tmp, Evt, TmsPer — all marked not supported on this map. Recorded so nobody goes looking., DER models 701, 702, 704, 705, 706, 707, 708, 709, 710, 711, 712 (US units only) — volt-var and volt-watt curves, low/high voltage and frequency trip points, frequency droop, watt-var, enter-service. Roughly 1500 registers of grid-support behaviour with no analogue anywhere in the contract. Four curve sets per model, with reversion timers., DERStorageCapacity(713) SoH — state-of-health. The contract HAS state-of-health; this map marks the register not supported, so the metric exists and the data does not., Smart Meter model 21x — grid import/export is signed and its meaning depends on Meter_Location (0 grid, 1 load, 3 external generator, 256-511 sub-load). There is no grid-power MetricKind, and the sign convention is what carries the import/export meaning. Same gap as Victron GX 820-822., SHAPE MISMATCH — per-phase AC. AphA/AphB/AphC, PhVphA/PhVphB/PhVphC and PPVphAB/PPVphBC/PPVphCA are all per-phase while ac-voltage and ac-current are single-valued. A 208/240 V split-phase cabin loses the split entirely., SHAPE MISMATCH — battery direction. On a storage build, charge lives in mppt module/3 (DCA/DCW zeroed while discharging) and discharge in module/4 (zeroed while charging), both unsigned. battery-current and battery-power are single signed values, so a driver must fuse two registers and invent the sign., SHAPE MISMATCH — battery voltage changed meaning mid-firmware. module/3/DCV and module/4/DCV read 0 in the inactive direction up to software 1.30; from 1.31 both report the inverter battery-port voltage regardless of direction. The same register address means two different things depending on firmware., state-of-charge is reachable two ways with different scales — storage(124) ChaState (% of AhrRtg, SF -2) and DERStorageCapacity(713) SoC (Pct, Pct_SF -2, US only). They are not documented as identical.
